nodes.name: Crea el nodo HTTP Request – Teams (Recovery)

parameters.query:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT
  @@SERVERNAME AS ServerName,
  GETUTCDATE() AS SampleUTC,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_reads)         AS r_reads,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_writes)        AS r_writes,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_bytes_read)    AS r_bytes_read,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_bytes_written) AS r_bytes_written
FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL, NULL) vfs
JOIN sys.databases d ON d.database_id = vfs.database_id;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT
  @@SERVERNAME AS ServerName,
  GETUTCDATE() AS SampleUTC,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_reads)         AS r_reads,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_writes)        AS r_writes,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_bytes_read)    AS r_bytes_read,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_bytes_written) AS r_bytes_written
FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL, NULL) vfs
JOIN sys.databases d ON d.database_id = vfs.database_id;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT
  @@SERVERNAME AS ServerName,
  GETUTCDATE() AS SampleUTC,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_reads)         AS r_reads,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_writes)        AS r_writes,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_bytes_read)    AS r_bytes_read,
  SUM(vfs.num_of_bytes_written) AS r_bytes_written
FROM sys.dm_io_virtual_file_stats(NULL, NULL) vfs
JOIN sys.databases d ON d.database_id = vfs.database_id;

USE OpsObservability;

DECLARE @inst int =
 (SELECT instance_id
  FROM dbo.monitoring_instance
  WHERE instance_name = N'Sislocar-Valencia-192.168.128.8');

DECLARE @last_ts datetime = (
  SELECT MAX(ts_utc)
  FROM dbo.monitoring_metric_timeseries
  WHERE instance_id=@inst
    AND metric_name IN ('cpu.sql.rt_pct','cpu.host.rt_pct','cpu.sql.5m_pct')
);

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN m.metric_name='cpu.sql.rt_pct'  THEN m.metric_value END) AS CPU_SQL_RealTime_pct_MotorSQL,
  MAX(CASE WHEN m.metric_name='cpu.host.rt_pct' THEN m.metric_value END) AS CPU_Host_RealTime_pct_VMManaged,
  MAX(CASE WHEN m.metric_name='cpu.sql.5m_pct'  THEN m.metric_value END) AS CPU_AzurePortal_5m_pct_Avg
FROM dbo.monitoring_metric_timeseries m
WHERE m.instance_id=@inst
  AND m.ts_utc = @last_ts
  AND m.metric_name IN ('cpu.sql.rt_pct','cpu.host.rt_pct','cpu.sql.5m_pct');

-- Baseline: sin filtros de tiempo ni métrica
DECLARE @id int =
(
  SELECT TOP (1) instance_id
  FROM dbo.monitoring_instance
  WHERE instance_name = N'{{$json.instance_name}}'
);

SELECT TOP 50
  ts_utc, scope_type, scope_key, metric_name, metric_value, rank_n, run_id
FROM dbo.monitoring_top_entities WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE instance_id = @id
ORDER BY ts_utc DESC, rank_n ASC;
